notes: Section 8, 1948 edition. Colour photograph cropped through the map: no frame rule anywhere, and the paper (with map ink) runs to the left, right and bottom page edges with no background visible (checked along every side), so the outline follows the page edge there (README rule 5). Top: from x ~2500 to the right corner a dark wedge enters from the top edge of the page (the photo is slightly turned; first clean paper row y 1 at x 2600-2800, 4 at x 3300, 7 at x 3900, 9 from x 4150 to the corner); the outline leaves the page edge at x 2480 and runs on paper 4-7 px below the wedge to (4763,15). No map ink is near the top edge there. 'remove' (owner, 2026-11-20): three kinds of printed block are deleted wherever they sit, each drawn as a simple outline a few px outside the block's ink, on paper: the 'CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP / LEGEND' block, compass roses / north arrows, and 'SECTION N' badges. remove[0]: the title and legend block with its six swatches (title lines x 3401-4065, y 315-623; legend x 3342-4133, y 644-829), stepped at y 634 because the legend rows run wider than the title lines, 7-10 px outside the ink, on plain paper (nearest other ink 37 px outside the outline). remove[1]: the 'SECTION 8' badge (ink x 4449-4600, y 61-213), an octagon 5-6 px outside the ring, on plain paper. remove[2]: the compass rose (ink x ~3530-3840, y ~1535-1840), turned ~40 degrees on this sheet, with its true-north needle (head tip ~3316,1316), the magnetic needle with its flag (tip ~3446,1239) and the long tail arrow down to ~4078,2083; 15 points, more than the usual 12 so that the outline hugs the two diverging needles and the tail, 8-13 px outside the ink. The compass is printed in the bay and touches no map ink, but map ink is close: the dash-dot PIER HEAD LINE with its lettering runs past the rose's south-west arm (nearest ink ~25 px from the arm tip, at ~3543,1834) and alongside the tail, and the big letters C / O of 'BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO' lie just beyond it. The outline passes between the rose and that line (13 px from the line at the vertex 3553,1826), so the PIER HEAD LINE, its lettering and the bay lettering all stay map. No ink lies under any outline (ink check: paper level only). Not removed, inside: the hand-lettered cross-reference 'Join Sec. 9' (lower right), BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, PIER HEAD LINE, FERRY BUILDING, pier numbers, the dotted box round MISSION ROCK (a real island), street names and block numbers. Stray marks inside remove[2]: a grey stain at ~3419,1368 and paper specks (one 2 px from the tail-side edge at ~3898,1862); not printed.
